Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: sanctions
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Every member must embargo the named faction for 60 days, and its economy suffers. Members who keep trading are in violation.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Every member must embargo {0} for 60 days; its economy falls by 5%. Members who keep trading with it are in breach.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: {0} goes unpunished, and its sponsor loses face.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: censure
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: A formal condemnation. Every member thinks less of the named faction, and its leader loses legitimacy.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Every member thinks less of {0} at once; its leader loses legitimacy and its people some faith in the regime.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: ceasefire order
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Orders two warring factions to make peace within 7 days and keep it for 60. Refusing, or restarting the war, is a violation.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: {0} and {1} must make peace within the grace period. Restarting the war is a breach by the aggressor.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: collective defence
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Names an aggressor. Within 10 days every member must stand against it, by war or by embargo, or be in violation. Allies and pact partners of the aggressor, and members already fighting two wars, are excused.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Every member must stand against {0}: declare war on it or at least embargo it. Its own allies and pact partners are excused.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: {0} is left free to pursue its war.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: common trade standard
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: For 120 days, members trade with each other on better terms (5% better prices) and their economies grow 2%.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Members trade with each other on 5% better terms, and every member's economy grows 2%.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: diplomatic immunity
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: For 180 days, attacking delegations or seizing envoys is a violation of council law.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Intercepting a delegation or capturing an envoy becomes a breach of the council's decree.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: Envoys travel at their own risk.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: ban on slavery
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: For 180 days, members may not keep slaves. Members found with slaves after 10 days are in violation.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: Members may not keep slaves. Keeping them after the grace period is a breach.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: Slavery stays a matter for each member.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: Federation Charter
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Founds a planetary federation led by your colony. Once passed, any major faction may sign Federation membership with you. Only you can propose it, after researching Planetary Federation. It never expires.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifPassed: The Planetary Federation is founded: members may join it, and the road to unification opens.
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.ifFailed: The Federation has to wait for another session.
